reason: The README describes an automation plugin that intercepts sandbox escalation requests and uses configurable presets or an LLM to allow, deny, or delegate elevated access, including danger-full-access; the permission-granting capability warrants human review.

summaries.zh: 通过预设或大模型裁决沙箱升权申请，并提供自定义权限层级、配置界面和审计日志的 DeepSeek Harness 审批自动化插件。
summaries.en: An automation plugin for DeepSeek Harness that evaluates sandbox escalation requests with presets or an LLM and provides custom permission levels, configuration controls, and audit logging.

capabilities: Uses an LLM to decide whether escalation is allowed, denied, or delegated
Can automatically authorize workspace-write and danger-full-access modes under configurable presets
Supports per-tool permission policies and configurable fallback behavior
Writes JSONL audit logs of decisions and outcomes
